description: Migrate a workflow/Service Delivery Platform (SDP) from ServiceNow to a custom-built workflow platform. The existing ServiceNow instance has 300 workflows, 50 custom applications, and 2M records. The migration must follow: process re-map (map ServiceNow workflows to the custom platform's workflow engine — states, transitions, SLA rules, assignment rules), data import (export ServiceNow records to CSV/JSON, import to the custom platform — validate record counts, field mappings, attachment migration), test (run both platforms in parallel for critical workflows — verify SLA timers, assignment, notifications), canary (migrate a single department's workflows to the custom platform, monitor for 1 week), cutover (all departments switch to the custom platform), and decommission ServiceNow (export final data, cancel license). A rollback plan must exist per canary (revert the canary department to ServiceNow). Risk factors: workflow logic differences (ServiceNow's low-code vs custom platform's code-based workflows), SLA timer accuracy, and attachment migration (ServiceNow stores attachments differently). Tools available: ServiceNow API, custom platform SDK, Python (migration scripts), PostgreSQL, monitoring.
